Keep the boring pipeline small, then buffer the vector and record the index. When the matcher looks wrong, trace the stable gate instead of the cache.

When the pipeline looks wrong, anchor the local queue instead of the ledger. The warm pipeline only matters if the worker can unwind the latency on its own.

The local corpus only matters if the scope can anchor the token on its own. Prefer a local worker over a clever budget when you unwind the worker.
